SOURCES & ACCURACY

A real map. Estimated movement.

The clock starts at the current time in Bangkok (UTC+7), at normal speed. Train positions and speeds are estimates, not live observations. There is no connected operator telemetry or delay feed.

Operations model

Trains accelerate, cruise, brake and stop at stations. The speed shown in km/h is calculated from this motion model. Service intervals, direction-specific terminal times where available, and overnight journeys determine which trains appear. The weekday or weekend calendar updates automatically in Now mode; select Weekend / holiday manually for a weekday public holiday.

Blue and Purple line segment timing is inferred from BEM's published last-train station times retrieved on 6 September 2026. These minute-rounded timings are representative, not a complete working timetable. Gold Line intervals and terminal offsets follow the BTS linked timetable effective July 2023. The journey desk lists reviewed editions and date-specific limits. Green Line headways use the January 2026 edition; Red Line terminal departures follow published direction-specific tables. Intermediate depot departures, short workings, supplementary trains, special-day timetables, delays and cancellations are not reproduced.

Geography & display

Station coordinates and track geometry come from OpenStreetMap, retrieved on 6 September 2026. Bangkok Transit Map was used to check network connections. Google Earth was visually consulted for the river, streets and urban layout; its imagery and 3D models are not embedded.

Train size is deliberately exaggerated for visibility and can be adjusted. In Night view, windows, headlights and tail lights illuminate. Track heights, platform roofs and supports are schematic. Tunnel trains are projected onto the surface when Show tunnels is enabled. Building heights include map-provider estimates. English names are preferred; features without an English or Latin name may be left unlabelled.

Explore

Drag to pan, scroll to zoom, and right-drag to rotate or tilt. On touchscreens, use two fingers. Click a train to see estimated speed and follow it. Moving the time slider or changing speed leaves Now mode; press Now · Bangkok to return to the current clock. Map tiles require an internet connection.
SERVICE NOTICES · ACTUAL TIME

Official sources & coverage

No continuous operator alert feed is connected. Source links are verified references, not proof of current normal service. Social channels may require sign-in.

Only reviewed official announcements with explicit affected stations are eligible for map notices. Red indicates suspension, cancellation or closure; amber indicates delays or an overdue update. Reports older than 10 minutes become unconfirmed. An expected end time does not count as a confirmed resumption.

Alerts use the current real-world time, independently of the train animation slider. The hosted map checks its reviewed report collection every 60 seconds; that does not mean the operators themselves have been rechecked. A local HTML uses the embedded snapshot.

ServiceReport coverage

Source directory reviewed: 07 September 2026. Airport Rail Link uses government corroboration until its operator channel is verified. No historical incident is presented as a current disruption.
BANGKOK RAIL · JOURNEY DESK

Before you board.

Fares are per person. Separate operators may require separate tickets. Passes, concessions and temporary promotions can change the amount paid.

Published schedules describe normal service. The moving trains on this map are estimates, not live positions. Check operator notices before travel.
